modules-for-folding-a-batch-of-registry-.text: Modules for folding a batch of registry requests.
Issue 746. This page places the new and changed code and fixes its dependency direction. Records are in the data model and signatures in the functions model.

changed-components.text: Paths are proposals. When the Lean models name a component differently, the code takes the model's name, and the mandate is versioned before the slice that creates it starts. The application record gains no field.

dependency-direction.text: The Singular package names no application: it finds requests by the policy the application record carries and keeps those the application's own decode accepts. The application that decodes its own requests hosts the command from its own package.
